programme.desc: After Benjamin gets lost in the woods, Peter and Lily give him a map to help him find his way home. But when the map falls into Mr Tod's hands, the rabbits must work together to stop the fox from finding their home.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. The Octonauts venture into a dangerous red-hot lava tube to rescue a teeny-tiny water bear who doesn't seem to mind the heat at all!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Letters A and I pair up to make the new and exciting sound AI, but will it help them on their journey?

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris plan a trip to Tippety Top to see the famous southern lights but lose each other in an ice fog. When Nugget thinks she sees a monster, Pancake proves to be an unlikely hero.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift make a new friend with an awesome roar, Steggy the Dinosaur! Together, they visit Tincy in the Sing Song Forest for a dinosaur song.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula have a penny each for the surprise machine in Padget's shop. Sula gets the silver rhino she wanted, so Bing is convinced he will get the alien he wants. When the surprise machine delivers his capsule, Bing is upset to discover that the alien is not inside.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘milk’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. There’s white milk, pink milk, baby milk and banana milk. We snuggle up for bedtime milk and even enjoy some mighty milk and monster milk! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu upsets Elodie when she laughs at an involuntary noise she makes.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri has to overcome her jealousy when everyone gives Lou presents.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in a shop filled with bric-a-brac where they watch a lady putting brightly coloured cardboard stars next to some items in the window display. She leaves the box of stars on the counter and goes into a back room. The Twirlywoos come out and take stars from the box, putting them next to as many different things as they can, until all the stars are used up. The lady comes back to discover that every item in the shop now has a star next to it! The Stop-Go Car visits the boat and brings the Twirlywoos some red, yellow and blue coloured blocks. The Twirlywoos decide to line them up, taking turns to place one colour next to the other. They make a long line of blocks which stretches across the boat, finishing outside Peekaboo's hole. While the Twirlywoos are busy celebrating, Peekaboo peeps out and knocks the end block, causing it to fall into the one next to it, until they all collapse, domino-style! This is repeated several times, with the Twirlywoos setting up the blocks and Peekaboo knocking them down again. In the end, the Twirlywoos chase after their rings, and Peekaboo takes the blocks into the hole.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin spends the day at his friend's school. They have lots of fun in the classroom, meeting the school dog and eating pizza. Meanwhile, it is Tumble Ted's first day at school and Mr Tumble pretends to be the teacher.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. Chip sings a heartfelt song about being a potato. Though he can't do many physical things, he is proud of who he is.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Joseph, Baani, Jean, Amber, Amelia, Luke and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are dollies which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding a safe, baby appropriate dolly inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun nursery rhyme ‘Miss Polly had a Dolly’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft hanging stars from twigs and colourful string, learn British Sign Language signs for twinkle, star and world, then sing and sign Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Food stylist Rob introduces the Fact Pack to edible flowers and explains how they can be used to make food look and taste exciting.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby rhino Maisha is in a bad mood, but her friends help her feel better. Hamza spots some fantastic colobus monkeys in the trees and searches for clues to find the elephants.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes must reclaim their yummy drops from the Beetrootsaurus.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring everything Duggee has grown in his vegetable garden, especially his crop of giant carrots, when they hear a noise. They investigate and find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice, the day when the sun is at its highest. On this day, they gather round Carrot Henge to celebrate the glory of this humble vegetable. Trouble is, the Rabbits need to go and get ready – but who will look after the carrots? The Squirrels volunteer, so off the Rabbits go. Looking after the carrots seems easy at first, and Norrie arranges tasks for everyone. Betty skillfully organises the queue while Roly is on toilet duty. And then, disaster strikes. Worm pops up and eats part of Carrot Henge. Duggee is dispatched to fetch one of his own giant carrots to fill the gap. As time ticks on with no Duggee in sight, the place gets busier, and the sun is nearly at the top. Will Duggee fix the Henge in time, or will Carrot Solstice be ruined?

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red and Blue meet Yellow and have fun colouring the seaside. Discover the colours around you.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Jasiri finds out some fascinating frog facts! Rory and his son Sandy hop like frogs to the local lochside and make a pond in their garden. Ferne visits an aquarium to meet some amazing amphibians including poison dart frogs. Also, we find out why frogs' place in the food web makes them so important to the balance of the planet.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet challenges her sister Amrit to a biking competition to see who can cycle around the bike track the fastest. But who will win? The bikes get really muddy, so Amanpreet takes charge of giving them a good clean and has some splashy fun with the hosepipe too. Later, she makes delicious shortbread for the whole family, including a special biscuit for little brother Arjun.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Diellza's family comes from Kosovo. She makes a traditional recipe of stuffed peppers. Diellza has lovely colourful ingredients for her stuffed peppers, such as spring onions, sweetcorn and grated carrot. She also uses cooked rice, chopped tomatoes, parsley, garlic puree and paprika for seasoning. This yummy filling is stuffed into her peppers and placed in the oven to be cooked for her friends. To accompany her meal, Diellza serves her friends a traditional Kosovan drink made of yoghurt and water called kos. Will they enjoy her drink, and will they guess what the special ingredient is?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today’s episode, Maddie explores how our body works. She visits a children’s hospital to find out what happens when we have an X-ray. She meets James, who has broken his arm, as well as a radiographer. We see what happens when we have an X-ray and learn how the X-ray machine takes a picture of the bones inside our body before saving the picture on a special machine. Next, Maddie heads to a factory where they make socks in lots of different colours out of yarn. Maddie uses her slow-motion camera to give us a special view when the sock-turning machine sucks in the socks and flips them out the right way around. They look like wiggly snakes!

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Guide dog Kika uses her super sight to help Dr Amit and his friend Alana play a game of sound tennis. Kika tries not to chase the noisy balls at the sports centre.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet the largest amphibians in the world, the Chinese giant salamander. They watch these secretive creatures emerge from their underwater rock shelters and use their amazing, superfast strike to grab their breakfast. Next, they meet a pair of Alaotran gentle lemurs. These beautiful creatures live in only one place in the wild – on the island of Madagascar. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona, Baba and Mossy babysit a little egg and help find its mama and papa.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has written a brilliant song, but his guitar string is broken, so he can't play it. Yukee decides to surprise Stripes by enlisting his garden friends to sing the song to him. The trouble is, they can’t find the right pitch to sing the song in!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are having a camping sleepover in their garden, but things take a mysterious twist when Dad discovers someone, or something, has been eating the vegetables in his patch. Maddie and Triggs turn super sleuths and conclude this is the work of a veggie monster!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels notice that Happy looks and seems different – he is frowning, his smile is upside down, and he’s wearing new trainers! When they check in on him, Happy is frustrated, but he can’t seem to identify where his frustration is coming from. They turn to Duggee for help, who uses his feeling cards to explain an array of feelings to Happy. All the Squirrels help by relaying their past experiences and the feelings that they evoked.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One finds a friendly furball, two of them tickle Two and soon Numberland is full of fun and fluffies! Have fun counting and learning how to make sevens with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. S is feeling a bit sad but T, A and P are there to help and before long, everyone is tap-dancing. T has no tea, A has too many apples, but S is sagging so the others want to help. P pops in and they try some word magic - perhaps a comforting pat or a big musical number? This episode introduces the letters S, A, T and P and the words sat, pat, tap and taps.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Rheagan on the slopes to take part in her skiing lesson. George joins in the snowy fun too! Meanwhile, Mr Tumble helps Tumble Ted get ready for a big adventure of his own. There's snowy activity in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words coat, helmet and ski slope.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po have their favourite things. The bag, the hat, the scooter and the ball all magically swap places and become mixed up.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back to the time of iberomesornis - a bird that lived in the forests of Spain 127 million years ago. His mission is to find some blue feathers belonging to the bird to replace the one he and Hatty accidentally lost back at the museum. Along the way he takes to the skies with one of the largest flying pterosaurs that ever lived. But will he succeed before the museum opens?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: The Fantastics find themselves up against the grown-ups in a big match! They think they’re going to win easily, but how will they respond when the grown-ups play surprisingly well?

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Series for young children that celebrates lots of different amazing machines. In this episode, motorcycle rider Grace Webb shows off three amazing machines that are all made to clean! First, Grace helps to clean a canal in a litter collection boat and shows off a brilliant ocean cleaner, and then she helps to clean an ice skating rink on an ice cleaner!

programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit

They learn about sound waves, and that you can listen for different qualities in the sounds, such as if it’s loud, quiet, high or low. Describing the sound can help you work out where it’s coming from, so Duggee lets the Squirrels close their eyes as they listen to sounds and make their guesses.

They use timers and the sun to track the edge of the puddle and find out how long it takes for a puddle to disappear.

programme.title: Stranger In Town
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed George Pollock. Starring Alex Nicol, Anne Paige & Mary Laura Wood. In a sleepy village, a composer is shot dead and a woman is found gassed. Who killed them and why? [S]

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: Lewis Allen. Stars Frank Sinatra, Sterling Hayden & James Gleason. Three gangsters trap a family in their own house, with the intention of killing the president of the USA. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Our for a Catch
programme.desc: 1964. A look into the fascinating aspects of angling, some of which are tragic. For example, the miles of inland waterway so polluted that no fish can live in them.

programme.title: No Trace
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Writer Robert Southley finds his lifestyle threatened by blackmail from a former US criminal associate. Stars Hugh Sinclair, Dinah Sheridan & John Laurie. [S]

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Lucy and George Burns. 1966. Stars Lucille Ball & Gale Gordon. When visiting the bank, George Burns finds out that Lucy is naturally funny and asks her to become a part of his show. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Reginald Le Borg. Stars Dan O'Herlihy, Phyllis Coates & Mary Scott. A British army captain has a chance meeting with the army nurse he romanced a decade earlier. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Penny Plains. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. An attempt is made on a wealthy woman's life. Marriott is put on the case but finds himself falling for her. [S]

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Return To Sender. 1963. Directed by Gordon Hales. Stars Nigel Davenport, Yvonne Romain, Geoffrey Keen & William Russel. Dino Steffano is arrested as he is about the leave the country. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Betrothal. 1955. Betrothal. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Rufus Cruickshank. Once again Sir Richard of the Lea has financial troubles due to his heavy gambling. [S]

programme.title: Dancing With Crime
programme.desc: 1947. Crime Drama. Directed by John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Richard Attenborough, Barry K. Barnes, Sheila Sim & Garry Marsh. A Cab driver gets mistaken with a gang. He sets out to expose the group. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: In this wonderful music video from the 60s, Italian singer and actress Mina performs Pesci Rossi.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Washday S.O.S. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Peter Illing & Gerard Heinz. Hunter goes undercover behind the Iron Curtain when the widow of a world-renowned doctor believes her husband is still alive. [S]

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: The Breach In The Dyke. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Out in France John gets separated from the division. Meanwhile, Margaret returns home. [S]

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: The Hazard of the Die. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. Hannay saves the life of a desperate woman, not knowing this act of bravery will bring him to his enemy. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Happy Go Lucky. 1964. Stars Kate Allitt, John Barrard & Michael Barrington. Nick Parks cannot stop stealing. Barlow gets a tip about an associate that may lead to the clearing of Nick's crimes. [S]

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1971. Detective & Mystery Drama. Come Into The Garden, Rose. Stars Alfred Burke, Margaret Anderson & Graham Armitage. Marker encounters some strong and powerful women. [S]

programme.title: Play for Today: Abigail's Party
programme.desc: Abigail's Party. 1978. Stars Alison Steadman, Tim Stern & Janine Duvitski. Middle-class suburbia gets to reveal its darker side over the course of an increasingly uncomfortable drinks party. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Opening the Cellar Club tonight is Caroline Munro, here to introduce the next episode of The Omega Factor! [S]

programme.title: The Omega Factor
programme.desc: Out of Body, Out of Mind. 1979. Stars James Hazeldine, Louise Jameson & John Carlisle. Michael has a newly discovered ability to dream of incidents which occur at places he has never been to. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Next up, Caroline Munro introduces the 1940s film Case of the Frightened Lady, staring Marius Goring, Penelope Dudley-Ward, Helen Haye & Ronald Shiner! [S]

programme.title: The Case of the Frightened Lady
programme.desc: 1940. Stars Marius Goring, Penelope Dudley-Ward & Helen Haye. Mark's Priory is the family seat of the Lebanons. Lady Lebanon is desperate to have an heir to carry on the family name. [S]
